messages:
Sam (acct-exec): Quick sync — GlobalBank wants evidence for an EU-only POC: KMS residency proof, a packet-capture showing no egress to non-EU regions, and a DPA/DPA addendum note. Can we produce these within 48h?
Priya (solutions): We can run a POC pinned to eu-west with Dedicated capacity. For Hosted we can do soft routing but not guarantee EU-only. Dedicated gives us the artifacts they want.
Tom (security): For KMS: with Dedicated we can provision keys in an EU KMS/HSM and provide key-id + CMK metadata. I can draft a short attestation stating keys are created and stored in eu-west HSMs.
Sam (acct-exec): Great. They also asked for an actual packet capture or connection logs that show egress endpoints. What's the fastest way to get that?
Marco (infra): Fastest is to spin up the POC env in eu-west, generate controlled traffic, and collect VPC flow logs + proxy logs + our outbound NAT IPs. We can also capture tcpdump on the POC host if they need pcap.
Priya (solutions): I'll prepare a runbook: exact traffic pattern, timestamps, endpoints to hit, and a checklist for capture. We'll include commands and a sample tcpdump: 
```
sudo tcpdump -w fintechco_eu_poc_2026-03-21.pcap host 10.2.3.4
```
Tom (security): For the DPA question: Lina, can we get a short paragraph confirming we accept EU data residency for the POC and will sign the standard DPA addendum? They want it in writing before kickoff.
Lina (legal): We can sign our standard EU addendum for a short-term POC. I need the customer's legal contact and a brief scope (data types, duration). Send me the contact and I'll prepare a countersigned copy within 24h.
Sam (acct-exec): Sending FinTechCo-legal now. Please include SLA language around "no cross-border egress" vs "best-effort within EU" — they keep asking for "hard guarantee".
Tom (security): Note: hard guarantee requires Dedicated with contractual failover constraints and likely extra indemnity. We need to flag that to Sales as a commercial ask.
Priya (solutions): Actionable delivery plan:
1) Marco to provision Dedicated eu-west POC (cpu/gpu profile TBC).
2) Priya to run traffic scenarios and collect pcap + flow logs.
3) Tom to generate KMS attestation and signed statement about logs.
4) Lina to send DPA addendum.
(We'll attach artifacts to the customer portal as PDFs.)
Marco (infra): Provisioning now. env: redwood-poc-globalbank-eu (id: poc-eu-339). ETA 2h.
deploy-bot: provision: redwood-poc-globalbank-eu created at 2026-03-21T16:12:43Z :white_check_mark:
Sam (acct-exec): Pricing note for the customer: Dedicated POC + EU KMS has a one-time setup fee and an uplift on monthly commit. Marco/Nina — can you give a rough number to include in the SOW draft?
Marco (infra): Rough estimate: one-week Dedicated POC = $5,000 infra + KMS usage fees (depends on encrypt/decrypt counts). Final pricing in SOW.
Tom (security): Also: ask customer to supply their vendor whitelist and whether they require subprocessors to be listed in the addendum. We'll map our subprocessors (docs.redwood.ai/subprocessors) against theirs.
Sam (acct-exec): I'll request whitelist and legal contact. Priya, can you include the exact test steps so they can witness the capture?
Priya (solutions): Yep. We'll give them step-by-step, including expected IP ranges and a small test app that emits controlled payloads.
Lina (legal): One more thing — if they require audit evidence with signed timestamps, Security can timestamp and sign the pcap/hash using our internal code-signing key. Confirm if they need that.
Sam (acct-exec): They said "signed evidence for auditors" — yes please.
Priya (solutions): OK, we'll produce pcap + sha256 + signed timestamp.
Marco (infra): POC ready in eu-west. Dropping temporary creds to SE channel.
Sam (acct-exec): Thanks everyone. I'll update GlobalBank and schedule the kickoff once DPA and pricing are attached. :thumbsup:
